description: A list of the recipes being converted.

description.description: A short description of the recipe which is displayed after the title. May include links to other recipes in markdown format.

photos.description: List of the paths to photos associated with this recipe

yield.description: The recipe's yield or servings including the unit if known

prepTime.description: How long it takes to prepare this recipe, eg. 3h30m

cookTime.description: How long it takes to cook this recipe, eg. 1h15m

totalTime.description: Total time it takes to prepare and cook the dish. This does not have to be the sum of prepTime and cookTime (but mostly is). eg. 4h45m

groupName.description: The name of the part of the recipe this group of ingredients makes. Empty if there's only one group

ingredients.description: A list of ingredients, each one's quantity, unit and name
The ingredients for the recipes, broken down into groups if needed

groupName.description: The name of the part of the recipe this set of instructions is for. Empty if there's only one group

items.description: A single instruction step for making the recipe, without preceding bullet point or number.

instructions.description: The instructions for making the recipe

notes.description: Any additional notes about the recipe that aren't a part of the description
